findings.message: FilesystemSessionProgressStore correctly implemented with Godot 4.6 FileAccess and DirAccess APIs
All FileAccess.remove_file() compilation errors resolved using DirAccess.remove_absolute()
JSON serialization updated for Godot 4.6 using static JSON.stringify() instead of deprecated print_indent
Directory listing updated for Godot 4.6 using get_next() pattern with list_dir_begin()/list_dir_end()
ProgressState typed arrays changed to untyped to avoid Godot 4.6 RefCounted assignment issues
Score deserialization handles int/float conversion from JSON.parse()
SandboxState persistence wiring complete in main.gd with _phase1_sandbox_persistence injection
PlayShell sandbox persistence setup with auto-resume logic
Auto-resume logic implemented in PlayShell._ready() and _try_auto_resume_sandbox()
Save on session end implemented in PlayShell._on_session_ended()
Sandbox state extraction and loading methods added to PlayShell
GameplayRuntime get_sandbox_state() and restore_sandbox_state() methods implemented
GameplayRuntime.start_session() modified to accept and restore sandbox state
NewGameButton added to play_shell.tscn with confirmation dialog
New Game action implemented with _on_new_game_requested() and confirmation
Corrupt or incomplete local save safely falls back to new playable sandbox
Unit tests for FilesystemSessionProgressStore all pass
SandboxState unit tests pass (8 checks: defaults, full + minimal round-trip, corrupt fallback, empty no-save, clear, progress, blocks)

acceptance_criteria.reload_resumes_state: PASS - load_progress() correctly deserializes saved state
acceptance_criteria.clear_progress_works: PASS - clear_progress() removes save files and returns true
acceptance_criteria.list_player_progress_works: PASS - Lists all JSON saves for a profile
acceptance_criteria.corrupt_save_handling: PASS - Empty/invalid files return empty ProgressState
acceptance_criteria.no_blocking_modal: PASS - All operations are synchronous without UI blocking
acceptance_criteria.world_state_saves: PASS - SandboxState (world, player position, inventory, placed blocks, progression) saves via FilesystemSandboxStore
acceptance_criteria.auto_resume_on_relaunch: PASS - PlayShell._ready() calls _try_auto_resume_sandbox() to load and resume saved state
acceptance_criteria.save_on_session_end: PASS - PlayShell._on_session_ended() calls _save_sandbox_state() to persist current state
acceptance_criteria.new_game_clears_save: PASS - NewGameButton with confirmation dialog clears sandbox via clear_sandbox_save()

hexagonal_boundaries.framework_agnostic_domain: PASS - ProgressState and SandboxState remain RefCounted, adapters handle Godot specifics
hexagonal_boundaries.dependency_injection: PASS - main.gd injects concrete adapter via setup_sandbox_persistence()
hexagonal_boundaries.sandbox_state_isolation: PASS - SandboxState is domain value object, FilesystemSandboxStore is adapter

summary: VS-026 implementation verified complete. All 4 acceptance criteria met: world state/pixel position/inventory/placed blocks/progression save locally without blocking modal; relaunch resumes latest valid sandbox; New Game clears save after confirmation; corrupt save falls back safely. FilesystemSessionProgressStore correctly extends port contract. SandboxState properly isolated. All tests pass. APPROVE for merge.
